Compiler.LockfileChecker.check.disposition: real fix: lockfile_path.read_text() now pins encoding="utf-8" - this is the entry that actually surfaced the bug: its own code contains em-dashes, so its stored code_hash was silently computed from a cp1252-mojibake decode on Windows (matching itself locally) until a GitHub Actions CI run (Linux, UTF-8 locale) computed the correct hash and correctly reported CODE_DIVERGED
